candidates.description: control: equal-weight ensemble of the four internal T2 R3 members (no external forecast)
candidates.weight_scheme: ENSEMBLE_EQUAL: equal weights over the members available at the origin, renormalised when a member is missing (the SPF member enters/leaves the set; the weights are recomputed, not fixed)
candidates.availability_rule: SPF median is public at the origin iff the survey quarter is real time (>= 1990Q3), the origin is the month-end of the middle month of the survey quarter (frozen protocol alignment) and the origin is on/after the official news-release date from src/amfe/ensemble/spf_calendar.py (docs/86 §5). Under protocol v4 the h=1/2/4 origins are quarter ends, so SPF enters only at h=0 middle-month origins; elsewhere the candidate falls back to the control.
candidates.fallback: if the SPF median is not public (or its values are not present in the git-ignored data directory), the SPF candidate uses exactly the control member set and reports spf_available=false, spf_fallback=true with the explicit reason
candidates.spf_attribution: Source: Federal Reserve Bank of Philadelphia, Survey of Professional Forecasters, median forecasts (https://www.philadelphiafed.org/surveys-and-data/real-time-data-research/survey-of-professional-forecasters); values used under research use terms, attribution required
candidates.note: defined by tools/spf_augmented_candidate.py; the Lead registers the candidate in protocols/candidates_*.json and the harness dispatcher before any evaluation
